name: Seceda ridge and the Pieralongia meadows
region: Puez-Odle Nature Park, Val Gardena, South Tyrol
why: Up by cable car to the Seceda ridge, where green meadows end in a sheer drop under the Odle spires, then mostly downhill through the Pieralongia meadows to Col Raiser.
book: Free path. Up with the Ortisei-Furnes-Seceda cable car, down with the Col Raiser gondola to Santa Cristina, then the Val Gardena bus back to Ortisei. Lifts run from about late May to early November; check the prices and hours on the lift sites.
water: Huts everywhere: Seceda, Baita Sofie, Malga Pieralongia, Col Raiser. No need to carry more than 0.5 l.
dangers: The ridge ends in a vertical drop: stay behind the fence at the viewpoint.
Thunderstorms in summer afternoons on the open ridge: the cable car stops in storms.

points.name: Seceda cable car top station
points.note: 2,456 m, top of the Ortisei-Furnes-Seceda cable car. Walk 10 minutes up the grass to the cross.

points.name: Seceda ridge with the Odle
points.note: 2,519 m, the famous view: the meadow tilts up to a knife edge and drops straight down, the Odle spires lined up behind.

points.name: Pieralongia
points.note: About 2,300 m, two tall rock needles in the meadows and a small hut, after an hour downhill on path 2A/1.

points.name: Col Raiser
points.note: 2,107 m, the top of the gondola to Santa Cristina, with the Sassolungo across the valley.
